svg.title: A nurse realizes that an entry just written in a client's paper medical record contains incorrect information. Which action should the nurse take?
svg.desc: An error is corrected by drawing a SINGLE LINE through it so the ORIGINAL ENTRY REMAINS LEGIBLE, labeling it as a mistaken entry, and adding initials and date. Correction fluid, erasing, or blacking out an entry destroys the original record and creates the appearance of TAMPERING with a legal document.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Documentation
Read the situation
A nurse realizes that an entry just
written in a client's paper medical record
contains incorrect information. Which
action should the nurse take?
What fits here
Draw a single line through the entry,
write 'mistaken entry,' and add initials
and the date
Why it fits
An error is corrected by drawing a SINGLE
LINE through it so the ORIGINAL ENTRY
REMAINS LEGIBLE, labeling it as a mistaken
entry, and adding initials and date.
Correction fluid, erasing, or blacking out
an entry destroys the original record and
creates the appearance of TAMPERING with a
legal document.
